title: Gulf Place Townhome Pool, Tennis & Beach Access
meta_description: Changes in Latitude: 3BR/2.5BA Gulf Place townhome with pool views, beach access, tennis & pickleball courts, bikes, and coastal décor. Sleeps 10 on 30A.
description_expanded: AboutChanges in Latitude | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental with 6-Seater Golf Cart, Gulf Place Pools, Pickleball and Steps to the Beach Santa Rosa Beach, Florida | Gulf Place on 30A | Sleeps 10 | 3 Bedrooms | 2.5 Bathrooms | 6-Seater Street-Legal Golf Cart | 3 Community Pools | 4 Pickleball Courts | Tennis | 3 Adult Bikes | Walk to Beach, Dining and Shopping Welcome to Changes in Latitude, a beautifully remodeled 30A vacation rental in Gulf Place offering the perfect combination of beach access, resort-style amenities, walkability, and relaxed coastal luxury. Located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach along Scenic Highway 30A, this spacious three-bedroom townhome sleeps up to 10 guests and now includes a 6-seater street-legal golf cart, making it even easier to explore 30A, nearby beaches, restaurants, shopping, and everything this sought-after area has to offer. Just steps from three beach access points, including the popular Ed Walline Regional Beach Access, Changes in Latitude puts the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico within easy reach. Guests can also walk to the shops, restaurants, and entertainment at Gulf Place, including local favorites such as Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar and The Perfect Pig. When you are not at the beach, enjoy three community swimming pools and hot tubs, four pickleball courts, a tennis court, nature trails, three adult bicycles, and free entertainment at the Gulf Place amphitheater. Back at the home, relax on the screened porch overlooking the pool, prepare frozen drinks with the margarita machine, grill dinner outside, or gather in the beautifully remodeled open-concept living space. Home Highlights • 6-seater street-legal golf cart included • Prime Gulf Place vacation rental on Scenic Highway 30A • Located in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach, Florida • Sleeps up to 10 guests • 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms • Fully remodeled kitchen and bathrooms • Beautiful new furnishings and thoughtfully designed coastal décor • Overlooks one of three large community swimming pools • Community hot tubs • Steps from three beach access points • Close to Ed Walline Regional Beach Access, featuring ADA accessibility, picnic shelters, restrooms, and seasonal lifeguards • Four pickleball courts • Tennis court • Scenic nature trail • Three adult bicycles • Walk to Gulf Place shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and the amphitheater • Free seasonal entertainment at the Gulf Place amphitheater • Walk to popular 30A restaurants and local favorites • Screened porch overlooking the community pool • Additional porch overlooking lush green spaces and nature trail • Open-concept living and dining area • Sleeper sofa in the living room • Fully stocked kitchen and spices • Margarita machine • Propane grill • Four backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella • Complimentary Wi-Fi • Thoughtful starter amenities provided upon arrival Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, and bottled water provided • Starter supply of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, dishwasher detergent, and laundry detergent pods • Starter bath amenities including shampoo, conditioner, lotion, soaps, and toilet paper • The Ultimate Gulf Place and 30A Location Location is everything on a 30A vacation, and Changes in Latitude puts you in one of Santa Rosa Beach's most desirable areas. Leave the car parked and enjoy the relaxed 30A lifestyle. Walk to the beach in the morning, grab lunch or dinner at Gulf Place, browse locally owned boutiques, enjoy live entertainment at the amphitheater, or take the 6-seater street-legal golf cart out to explore more of Scenic Highway 30A. The home is conveniently located near Ed Walline Regional Beach Access, one of South Walton's most popular public beach accesses. Guests can spend their days enjoying the beautiful emerald-green waters and sugar-white sand that have made Santa Rosa Beach and 30A one of Florida's most sought-after vacation destinations. After the beach, walk to popular local restaurants such as Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar and The Perfect Pig, grab ice cream with the family, explore the boutiques at Gulf Place, or enjoy outdoor entertainment without having to travel far from home. Beautifully Remodeled Coastal Living Changes in Latitude has been thoughtfully updated with a fully remodeled kitchen, remodeled bathrooms, new furnishings, and inviting coastal décor designed to create a relaxing yet elevated beach vacation experience. The main level features a spacious open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area, providing plenty of room for families and friends to spend time together. The fully stocked kitchen makes everything from a quick beach-day breakfast to a family dinner easy, while the margarita machine adds a little extra vacation fun. Fire up the propane grill for an easy dinner after a day at the beach or pickleball courts. The comfortable living room provides a welcoming place to relax in the evenings, and the new sofa includes a sleeper sofa for additional sleeping accommodations. Step outside onto the screened porch and enjoy peaceful views overlooking one of the community pools—the perfect place for morning coffee, an afternoon break from the beach, or a relaxing evening. First Floor The first floor is designed for gathering and convenience and includes: • Open-concept living room • Sleeper sofa • Dining area • Fully remodeled and stocked kitchen • Screened porch overlooking the community pool • Bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds • Half bathroom • Convenient access to the home's outdoor spaces and community amenities The bunk room is especially fun for children and younger guests, making Changes in Latitude an excellent choice for family vacations on 30A. Second Floor • Upstairs, guests will find two spacious king suites designed for privacy and relaxation. • The beautiful primary king suite features a private balcony overlooking the pool and an ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub and separate walk-in shower, creating a comfortable retreat for another couple or family members. Three Pools, Pickleball, Tennis and More A stay at Changes in Latitude offers much more than an incredible beach location. Guests have access to an outstanding collection of Gulf Place amenities, including: • Three community swimming pools • Community hot tubs • Four pickleball courts • Tennis court • Nature trails • Green spaces • Gulf Place amphitheater • Seasonal entertainment and events • Boutique shopping • Restaurants and casual dining • Easy access to the beach Whether your perfect vacation means playing pickleball in the morning, spending the afternoon at the beach, relaxing poolside, biking along 30A, or walking to dinner and live entertainment, everything is conveniently nearby. Explore 30A with a 6-Seater Street-Legal Golf Cart One of the best additions to Changes in Latitude is the included 6-seater street-legal golf cart. Load up the family and enjoy an easy, fun way to explore the surrounding area, visit nearby beach accesses, head to restaurants, or simply experience the laid-back atmosphere that makes Scenic Highway 30A so special. Combined with the home's three adult bicycles, you have multiple ways to leave the car behind and experience the area like a local. Beach Ready We've made beach days easier by providing: • Four backpack beach chairs • Beach umbrella • Three adult bicycles With multiple nearby beach access points and Ed Walline Regional Beach Access close by, you can spend less time preparing and more time enjoying the Gulf of Mexico. Thoughtful Extras for Your Arrival After traveling, the last thing you want to do is immediately run to the store. Changes in Latitude includes a thoughtful starter package to help you settle in. Upon arrival, you'll find Starbucks coffee, creamer, sugar, bottled water, and starter supplies including paper towels, dish soap, a sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher detergent, laundry detergent pods, shampoo, conditioner, lotion, bathroom soaps, and toilet paper in each bathroom. It's one more way we make your 30A vacation comfortable from the moment you arrive. Your 30A Vacation Starts at Changes in Latitude Whether you're planning a family beach vacation, couples getaway, pickleball vacation, Gulf Place getaway, or relaxing escape to Santa Rosa Beach, Changes in Latitude offers everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Spend mornings walking to the beach, afternoons beside the pool or playing pickleball, and evenings cruising in the 6-seater street-legal golf cart before walking to dinner and entertainment at Gulf Place. With a beautifully remodeled interior, three bedrooms, two king suites, a fun bunk room, three community pools, hot tubs, four pickleball courts, tennis, bicycles, beach equipment, a street-legal golf cart, and an exceptional location near the beach, Changes in Latitude is the 30A vacation rental you've been searching for. Book Changes in Latitude and experience the best of Gulf Place, Santa Rosa Beach, and Scenic Highway 30A.
